note: Imported by tools/import_headwear_green.py from a sheet whose person was painted flat #00FF00. The hat is simply everything that is neither the magenta backdrop nor the green person, so no head can leak into the frame and no colour heuristic can eat a hat pixel. The green silhouette also registers the cell against the mannequin on the WHOLE body rather than the torso alone. anchors are the hat bbox top-centre, crownNudge is anchor minus body-tops stand-<dir>-0, scale is 1. v2.3.1514: nudged by hand dx +0 dy +10 on south. v2.3.1514: nudged by hand dx +0 dy +3 on north. v2.3.1527: hair-clip mask rebuilt from the current art by tools/make_hairmask.py, and clipsHair switched on. v2.3.1529: hair-clip mask rebuilt from the current art by tools/make_hairmask.py. v2.3.1532: clipsHair OFF and the hairmask folder DELETED. This is a band across the forehead, not a cap -- it leaves the whole crown bare, so clipping the hair to it shaved the scalp (owner: "dont hair clip the Naruto headwear on some angles the hair is bald"; measured worst-case exposed scalp: naruto-headband 603px, bandana-2 393px, bandana-blue 380px, against 65px for the worst real cap). The folder is deleted rather than kept because make_hairmask.py treats the presence of a hairmask folder as the record that a hat covers the skull, and --all-with-masks would switch the flag straight back on. Nothing pokes through: the hair layer renders BELOW headwear, so the band draws over it. v2.3.1924: per-facing size fitted by tools/fit-headwear-scale.mjs. The five stand sheets draw the head at five different widths (43/52/45/44/41 in the 256 frame) and BODY_DIR_SCALE cancels out of the hat/head ratio, so a hat drawn one size renders a different size on every facing. scale[dir] now moves the facings that disagree onto the median of the ones that agree, measured as drawn WIDTH over head width, bounded to 15%, and skipped entirely on a facing whose aspect ratio says the silhouette itself changed. A facing that GREW carries a crownNudge Y that holds its bottom edge still.
